source.name: Nova Scotia Provincial Ambient Hourly air quality data
corrections: The dataset "Nova Scotia Provincial Ambient Carbon Monoxide (CO) Hourly Data Sydney" lists 2,557 hours from 2010 to 2016 with seconds after the hour in the stamp. Each is read as the hour, and no other row holds that hour.
The dataset "Nova Scotia Provincial Ambient Ground-level Ozone (O3) Hourly Data Aylesford" lists 8,760 hours in 2017 under the station name "Alyesford". They are read as Aylesford.

The dataset "Nova Scotia Provincial Ambient Nitrogen Oxides (NOx, NO2, NO) Hourly Data Lake Major" lists two different values for the same hour in 1 hour of Lake Major NO in 2018. No value is chosen, and those hours show as missing.

The dataset "Nova Scotia Provincial Ambient Nitrogen Oxides (NOx, NO2, NO) Hourly Data Lake Major" lists two different values for the same hour in 1 hour of Lake Major NOX in 2018. No value is chosen, and those hours show as missing.

The dataset "Nova Scotia Provincial Ambient Sulphur Dioxide (SO2) Hourly Data Lake Major" lists 8,760 hours from 2022 to 2023 under the pollutant O3, which the dataset does not hold. These rows are left out, and the hours show as missing.
